The ring is built by 0x5560cc: [0x866ec0] = start, [0x866eb8] = end, [0x866ebc] = end - start (0x556104 'sub edi,[0x866ec0]'), a closed cycle [start,end). Here start = 0x8943a0 (record 0), end = record 26 (0x896760), size 26 records (0x23c0): one valid instance of that invariant (the layout cannot vary end and size jointly), and spec ebx rec[0x8943a0,0x160,0..25] is on the cycle, so every visited record is 0..25 and both 'jb' outcomes occur. Termination of the final walk 0x5571aa..0x5571c8 ('test [ebx+0x3c],dl; jne' stop): the last record marked before it, at 0x55714f, gets +0x3c |= dl from 0x5591f9; 0x559287/0x559310 after it write only +0x1c/+0x1d/+0x24/+0x25/+0x92 and the 0x6f3cd4 pan table, and 0x559244->0x559253 in the walk only mask records whose dl bits are already clear, so the walk returns to that record within 26 steps (an off-cycle start, as the ring_008943a0/bits_0055616f end/size draws allow, can loop forever and is not a state 0x5560cc produces). Repeat count word [0x874b50] (stream word +2 in 0x557023, any u16 from the stream; zero in the image): 'cmp word,1; jle' (signed) then 'sub word,1; jne' - passes = count when count >= 2, else one; drawn from {0xffff,0x8000,0,1,2,3,4,5} so both jle outcomes occur (small loop counts per the protocol; larger counts repeat the same body and only multiply run time).
